items.claim: 全年 NII ex Markets 與總 NII 財測上調，Markets NII 升至約 90 億
items.quote: we now expect NII ex Markets to be about $96.5 billion
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: 全年調整後費用財測上調至約 1,075 億，主因與量及營收相關的費用
items.quote: the new adjusted expense outlook is about $107.5 billion
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: 卡片淨沖銷率財測調整為約 3.2%，理由是消費信用優於預期
items.quote: Card net charge-off rate to be approximately 3.2%
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: NII ex Markets 上調的最大單一因素是存款餘額，利率只是小部分
items.quote: the biggest single factor is deposit balances
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: 消費端存款今年低個位數成長的預期不變
items.quote: we talked about expecting low single-digit growth this year
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: 管理層拆解費用上調 25 億：15 億已在上半年入帳，另隱含下半年 10 億
items.quote: of the $2.5 billion that we increased guidance, $1.5 billion
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: 上半年資本市場相關營收超出當初預期 65 億，並帶來 15 億額外費用
items.quote: outperformed our then expectations by $6.5 billion
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: Markets NII 上調來自資產負債表組成變化，非利率；另有約 1.5 億由股權配置從 Corporate 移到 CIB
items.quote: it's probably like $150 million
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: Dimon 說明營收增加時邊際報酬高於平均，營運槓桿觀點
items.quote: since you're not adding all the overhead
items.speaker: James Dimon

items.claim: Barnum 說明 Q2 營收年增 15%、費用年增 15% 及淨沖銷/準備金數字
items.quote: Expenses of $27.3 billion were up 15% year-on-year
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: Dimon 認為 AI 效益會歸客戶而非銀行，不會讓利潤率無限上升
items.quote: If that were true, our margins would be 80% today
items.speaker: James Dimon

items.claim: Barnum 提到存款 beta 優於模型，實際利率敏感度可能高於 EaR 顯示
items.quote: outperformance of the Consumer betas relative to the model
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: Token 費用上半年微不足道，預期下半年明顯加速，但全年仍屬微小
items.quote: it is a trivial number for the first half of the year
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: Dimon 預期費用成長可能在 2027 或 2028 放緩，但表示無法預測
items.quote: maybe a slowdown in '27 or '28
items.speaker: James Dimon

items.claim: Smart Cash 工具仍屬測試，Dimon 承諾今年會看到動作
items.quote: Yes, you'll see something this year.
items.speaker: James Dimon

items.claim: 對支出的態度：持續投資、與前幾年一致，無改變
items.quote: a complete continuation of what we've been doing for years
items.speaker: James Dimon

items.claim: 董事會將季度股利提高至每股 1.65 美元，第三季生效
items.quote: increase the quarterly dividend to $1.65 per share
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: 接班時程：Dimon 稱與上次所說相同，約幾年，由董事會決定
items.quote: Several years, you can use a few years
items.speaker: James Dimon

items.claim: Dimon 更正上次提到的 200 億回購說法，並說可以多於此數或完全不做
items.quote: I made a mistake last time mentioning $20 billion.
items.speaker: James Dimon

items.claim: Dimon 表示股價越高越少買回；多餘資本傾向部署於有機成長
items.quote: we want to buy back less stock as the price goes up
items.speaker: James Dimon

items.claim: 資本部署目標為 17% 報酬
items.quote: the goal is to deploy our capital at a 17% return
items.speaker: James Dimon

items.claim: CET1 比率 14.1%，較上季下降 20bp，RWA 增加約 1,030 億
items.quote: standardized CET1 ratio of 14.1%, down 20 basis points
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: CIB 資本配置是回應客戶需求，另有波動與股價上漲帶來的被動效應
items.quote: you've got active and passive effects
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: Dimon 表示對併購保持開放，並承認今年有些交易不特別好
items.quote: most were good, a couple weren't particularly good
items.speaker: James Dimon

items.claim: Dimon 點名競爭對手包括 Goldman 與多家金融科技公司
items.quote: you've got Stripe and PayPal and Cash and Block and Chime
items.speaker: James Dimon

items.claim: Barnum 指出 G-SIB 短期批發融資修改對同時有市場與消費業務的銀行負擔較重
items.quote: increase the burden on banks like us and Bank of America
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: Dimon 認為 AI 也會經由 Fiserv、FIS 等提供給較小的競爭者
items.quote: this will be offered to smaller competitors, too
items.speaker: James Dimon

items.claim: Barnum 說同業資料中心放款有放寬，JPM 婉拒部分交易，整體屬正常競爭壓力
items.quote: we passed on some deals
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: 投行費用年增 30%，股權承銷特別強，部分來自大型 ECM 案與併購提前完成
items.quote: IB fees were up 30% year-on-year
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: 股票業務營收年增 86%
items.quote: revenue up 86% year-on-year
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: Chase UK 約 250–300 萬客戶，德國已開業但尚未獲利
items.quote: it's not quite profitable yet
items.speaker: James Dimon

items.claim: Dimon 描述 AI 使用案例數與其對效率的預期
items.quote: almost 1,000 use cases today
items.speaker: James Dimon

items.claim: AWM 長期淨流入 500 億，AUM 5.1 兆
items.quote: Long-term net inflows were $50 billion
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: Dimon 回答是否已是高點：接近最佳但不知道能維持多久
items.quote: It's getting close to as good as it gets.
items.speaker: James Dimon

items.claim: Barnum 說股票業務本季特殊組合難以重複
items.quote: a little bit hard to imagine that being repeated
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: 投行本季有提前與大型交易貢獻，管理層承認有 pull-forward 但管線仍強
items.quote: clearly, there was some pull-forward
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: Dimon 指出同業承銷標準出現輕微弱化（PIK、契約、展期風險）
items.quote: you've seen a little bit of weakness
items.speaker: James Dimon

items.claim: Barnum 指出存款利率支付的負凸性遲早會出現，高利率情境並非單純有利
items.quote: you have to believe that at some point, that kicks in
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: 對消費者：K 型敘事支持不多，但有實質薪資為負的族群值得觀察，信用主要看勞動市場
items.quote: it's just about the labor market
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: Dimon 批評監管資本計算有重複計算，列出四項應修改處
items.quote: get rid of the double count in operating risk capital
items.speaker: James Dimon

items.claim: 消費者與小企業展現韌性，支出強勁，淨新增支票帳戶逾 50 萬
items.quote: net new checking account growth of over 500,000 accounts
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: 批發存款上半年優於預期，部分來自 NBFI 與資料中心放款創造存款
items.quote: loans creating deposits
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: 管理層對 CapEx 與放款成長是否與 AI 相關無法明確區分
items.quote: might still be, but on the other hand, it might not
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

items.claim: 消費端 15% 零售份額被描述為策略執行的結果而非目標改變
items.quote: the 15% will be an outcome of that
items.speaker: Jeremy Barnum

qa_flags.question: Usdin/Penala：領導層異動（Marianne Lake 退休、兩位共同總裁）與 Dimon 任期、接班特徵
qa_flags.response_pattern: Dimon 回「No mystery」「timing is essentially the same」，被追問時只說「幾年、plus or minus、由董事會決定」，未給明確時間

qa_flags.question: Mitchell：未來幾年費用成長是否放緩、營運槓桿是否可能為正
qa_flags.response_pattern: Dimon 稱追求更高營運槓桿是「crazy notion」，只說「we can't project」並提 27/28 年可能放緩；Barnum 轉談邊際營運槓桿

qa_flags.question: Poonawala：為何在 3 倍帳面價值時仍回購、是否多留資本
qa_flags.response_pattern: Dimon 同意原則，但稱不會告訴市場要做什麼（'not going to tell you what they are'），並更正上次 200 億說法，不給數字

qa_flags.question: Gosalia：CIB 資本配置是否已達高點、是否有內部上限
qa_flags.response_pattern: Barnum 明說不討論內部限額管理，改談客戶需求與主被動效應，未回答是否已到高點

qa_flags.question: Usdin：投行與市場業績可持續性
qa_flags.response_pattern: Barnum 表示「don't want to get into guiding」，稱只是猜測，承認有 pull-forward 但稱管線強健
